articles.title: EWU's Marcus McCurty springs into action after FAA ground stoppage disrupts football team's travel plans: 'I was weirdly calm' - Sat, 14 Nov 2026 PST
articles.description: ST. GEORGE, Utah – Fewer than a dozen people remained in line at Signature Flight Support’s security station on Friday when word came to Marcus McCurty that Eastern Washington’s chartered plane – and the rest of them at the Spokane International Airport – wasn’t going anywhere anytime soon.
